description: Modify the test configuration to disable flow heartbeats by default during test execution. This will prevent background heartbeat threads from being spawned in tests, reducing test execution time and preventing CI timeouts. The change should maintain existing heartbeat-specific test functionality while ensuring test settings properly reflect the test environment configuration.
functional_requirements: Update the test session profile configuration to set the heartbeat frequency to None for all tests
Ensure heartbeat-specific tests continue to work correctly by maintaining their existing mocking approach
Fix any test cases that incorrectly use Settings() instead of get_current_settings() to properly respect test environment configuration
